📈 Hall Shares

Hall Shares are earned by running (1 for every 100 m, up to 100 a day). They can't be bought with money and can't be turned into cash, Gold Stars or anything in the store. Prices move with what every player buys and sells. 18+ only.

💾 Your progress

✓ Saves by itselfEverything you do is saved in this browser straight away: coins, stars, runners, records and your school. There's nothing to press. Come back any time on this computer and it's all here.
☁️ Play on other devices tooSign in with Google once and your progress saves to your account by itself after every run. Sign in on any other browser to carry on there. It's only used to find your save. Nothing is posted and nobody else can see it.

    How to Play

    Move: ←/A and →/D   Jump: ↑/W/Space   Slide: ↓/S   Pause: P/Esc

    📱 Touch: swipe left, right, up or down.

    ⬆️ Jump over low stuff: trash cans, wet-floor signs, dropped backpacks, mop buckets.

    ⬇️ Slide under high stuff: spirit banners, posters kids are carrying, swinging mops.

    ↔️ Switch lanes around people: chatting groups, pairs walking and talking, kids at their lockers, classes walking in line, janitor carts, hall monitors and teachers, who may step into your lane yelling "NO RUNNING!"

    🎒 Backpack load starts at 100%. Heavy bags mean lower jumps, slower lane changes and longer slides. Each power-up drops it 10% (down to 20%). Gear in the Locker Room lowers it for good.

    🎫 Hall Pass: invincible for 6s.  📝 Cheat Sheet: time slows 50%, score keeps full speed.  🧃 Juice Box: speed boost + coin magnet.

    🪙 Coins = $1, 💵 Bills = $5. Spend them in the Locker Room. Bumping something from the side makes you stumble; stumble twice and you get caught!

    School Year Pass

    Tier 0

    Earn XP from every run: distance, coins, skate tricks, escaped chases and missions. The free track is for everyone; the 👑 Gold Track adds a second, bigger reward on every tier.

    Play Modes

    Difficulty (Infinite & modes)
    Harder = faster start, more obstacles and a higher top speed, but there's always an open lane. Hard scores x1.5, Insane x2.
    Speed
    Faster runs score more: Fast x1.25, Turbo x1.6 (Chill x0.8). Works in every mode.

      ⚔️ Duel a Friend

      You both run the same hallway. While you run, your friend's score sits next to yours on the side of the screen so you can see who's winning.

      1. Start a duelRun a fresh hallway. When you finish, tap Copy duel code and send it to your friend.
      2. Got a code from a friend?Paste it here (like MAYA-5K2-AB3) to race their score on their hallway.

      Controls

      ⌨️ Keyboard

      ←→ or AD switch lanes

      ↑ W Space jump

      ↓ S slide

      Q or F push people

      E or H heel wheels

      X combo finisher

      P or Esc pause

      Space/Enter or click: start a run

      R restart the run

      M back to the menu

      L leaderboard

      O play modes · U duel a friend

      1–4 difficulty (Easy to Insane, on the menu)

      N music on/off · V sound effects on/off

      Esc back (on menus)

      C show these controls

      F full screen (on the menu)

      👆 Touch / mouse

      Swipe (or drag) left / right: switch lanes

      Swipe up: jump (swipe a moment before you land and you jump again right away)

      Swipe down: slide

      ✋ button: push · 👟 button or double-tap: heel wheels

      💥 button: finisher (at x3 combo)

      🛠 Admin

      During a run (open Admin from Pause):
      Admin runs and god mode never go to the online leaderboard or tournament.

          🏫 School board rules

          • Use a username, never your real name.
          • Don't share your address, phone, social media or anyone else's info.
          • School names must be the school's real name. No jokes about people.
          • No bad words, bullying or hate. Breaking the rules gets you removed.
          • Tap 🚩 next to anyone who breaks them. A moderator checks new schools and reports, and hides anything that breaks the rules.

          🛡 Owner sign-in

          Only the game owner's account can moderate. The database itself checks who you are.
